div.head: Cn 1018
div.ab: And witena gerædnes is. þæt man eard georne clænsian onginne. on æghwilcon ende 7 manfulra dæda æghwar geswice. 7 gif wiccan oððe wigleras. morðwirhtan oððe hórcwenan. ahwar on lande wurðan agitene. fise hi man georne ut of þisan earde. oððe on earde forfare hi mid ealle buton hi geswican. 7 þe deoppor gebetan.

And the decree of the councillors is that cleansing of the land be begun everywhere and that evil deeds cease everywhere, and if wizards or sorcerers, secret murderers or prostitutes are encountered anywhere in the land, that they be zealously driven out of this land, or completely destroyed in the land, unless they cease, and the more deeply make amends.
